title: Branch hours
text: Branches are open Monday to Thursday 9 AM to 5 PM, Friday 9 AM to 6 PM with a lunch break 1 to 2:30 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to 1:30 PM at selected branches only. Closed Sunday.

title: Ramadan hours
text: During Ramadan, hours are typically 8 AM to 1:45 PM Monday to Thursday, and 8 AM to 12:30 PM on Friday. Exact hours can vary by branch.

title: Islamabad Corporate Centre
text: HBL Islamabad Corporate Centre is at HBL Tower, Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area, Islamabad. Phone (051) 2872203.

title: Head Office, Karachi
text: HBL Head Office is at HBL Tower, Plot G-4, KDA Scheme 5, Block 7, Clifton, Karachi. Phone (021) 33116030.

title: PLS Savings Account
text: The HBL PLS Savings Account has no minimum balance requirement and unlimited transactions. Profit is calculated monthly and paid out semi-annually. Confirm the current profit rate via customer care, as it changes periodically.

title: Value Account
text: The HBL Value Account is a higher-return savings account requiring a PKR 40,000 average monthly balance. Profit is paid quarterly, tiered by deposit amount. Only one may be opened per CNIC.

title: Conventional Current Account
text: The HBL Conventional Current Account allows unlimited transactions with no profit paid, for customers with frequent day-to-day banking activity.

title: Basic Banking Account
text: The HBL Basic Banking Account is a simple account for minimal transactional needs, with unlimited free ATM withdrawals on HBL's own network and 2 free over-the-counter withdrawals per month.

title: Asaan Account
text: The HBL Asaan Account is a simplified current account for new-to-bank individuals aged 18+, opened with just a CNIC or SNIC. No profit is paid, as it's a current account.

title: Rutba senior citizen account
text: HBL Rutba is a conventional savings account for senior citizens aged 55 and above, with no minimum balance, monthly profit payout, and a free first cheque book.

title: Nisa women's accounts
text: HBL Nisa is a family of conventional accounts for women: Nisa Savings, Nisa Asaan (simplified current account for new-to-bank women), and Nisa Plus (full current account). Ask which one a caller means.

title: Credit card tiers
text: HBL offers Platinum, Gold, Green, and FuelSaver CreditCards. Platinum includes airport lounge access and travel benefits; Gold and Green offer reward points; FuelSaver gives cashback on fuel purchases.

title: Credit card annual fees
text: Annual credit card fees range roughly from PKR 1,500 to PKR 12,000 depending on tier, with fee reversal available if annual spend thresholds are met. Confirm exact fees against the current Key Fact Sheet.

title: Credit card markup rate
text: The markup rate on outstanding credit card balances is approximately 3.5% per month, subject to State Bank of Pakistan regulation and periodic revision.

title: Lost or stolen credit card
text: Report a lost or stolen card immediately to HBL PhoneBanking on 111-111-425 to secure the account against unauthorized transactions.

title: Personal loan overview
text: The HBL Personal Loan is unsecured, from PKR 25,000 to PKR 3,000,000, for salaried customers with salary credited to an HBL account, aged 21 to 61, minimum salary PKR 35,000 per month.

title: Personal loan rate and repayment
text: Personal loan interest is up to 35.99% per annum depending on the applicant's profile, repayable over 12, 24, 36, 48, or 60 months. Pensioners are eligible up to PKR 1,000,000.

title: Islamic banking overview
text: HBL Sadiq offers Shariah-compliant banking approved by HBL's Shariah Board. Describe returns as profit rate or profit-sharing ratio, never as interest, since these products avoid conventional interest.

title: Islamic accounts
text: Islamic savings options include the HBL Islamic PLS, Uraan, and Mahana Amdan accounts. Islamic term deposits use the Mudaraba principle, sharing profit between customer and bank per an agreed ratio.

title: Islamic personal financing
text: HBL Islamic Consumer Financing is a Shariah-compliant alternative to a conventional personal loan, structured as Murabaha or a similar Islamic financing arrangement rather than interest-based lending.

title: HBL Mobile app
text: The HBL Mobile app supports fund transfers, bill payments, statements, card blocking and unblocking, Zakat payments, QR payments, and setting personal transaction limits.

title: Internet Banking and PhoneBanking
text: HBL Internet Banking offers the same self-service features as the mobile app via a web browser. HBL PhoneBanking on 111-111-425 handles card reporting, account queries, and complaints.

title: HBL FastTransfer
text: HBL FastTransfer lets Pakistanis abroad send money home free of charge to the sender. Beneficiaries collect cash at any HBL branch without needing an account, or receive it by deposit.

title: Remittance contact and tracking
text: Track a remittance with the HBL Remittance Tracker using the transaction reference number. For remittance-specific queries call 021-111-555-425 or email home.remittance@hbl.com.

title: Reporting a lost card
text: If you lose your card, report it immediately to HBL PhoneBanking on 111-111-425. The account is secured against unauthorized use on that card as soon as it's reported.

title: Filing a complaint
text: File a complaint by texting comp plus your CNIC to 4250, emailing customer.complaints@hbl.com, using the online form, or calling 111-111-425. A reference number is issued within 2 working days.

title: Documents to open an account
text: Opening an account requires a valid CNIC or SNIC for resident Pakistanis, or a NICOP or POC for overseas Pakistanis. Some accounts require additional proof of income.

title: General contact numbers
text: Customer care and PhoneBanking: 111-111-425. Complaints: customer.complaints@hbl.com. Remittance queries: 021-111-555-425 or home.remittance@hbl.com.
